newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: ICN, Bosnian Serbs initial drug deal - paper.
newsitem.headline: ICN, Bosnian Serbs initial drug deal - paper.

text.p: ICN Pharmaceuticals Inc. and Krajinalek of Banja Luka have initialled an agreement to found a joint limited liability company, the Belgrade daily Nasa Borba reported on Monday.
The drug company, ICN-Krajinalek, will set up its headquarters in Banja Luka and use production facilities in western and eastern parts of the Bosnian Serb Republic.
The deal was initialled in Pale on Saturday by ICN Pharmaceuticals Inc. president Milan Panic and Bosnian Serb health minister Dragan Kalinic, the paper said.
No other details of the project were available. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 2224305
